definitions.explanation: The third finger of the hand, located between the index finger and the ring finger.

examples.japanese: {中指|なかゆび}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{指輪|ゆびわ}→指輪：01744_yubiwa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦はめる→嵌める：04255_hameru⟧。
examples.english: Put a ring on the middle finger.

examples.japanese: {中指|なかゆび}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{五本|ごほん}→五本：noentry⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{指|ゆび}→指：01518_yubi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧。
examples.english: The middle finger is the longest of the five fingers.

examples.japanese: {中指|なかゆび}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{怪我|けが}した→けが：00787_kega⟧。
⟦{右手|みぎて}→右手：10438_migite⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{中指|なかゆび}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ばんそうこう→絆創膏：05386_bansoukou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{貼|は}っている→貼る：10447_haru⟧。
examples.english: I have a bandage on my right middle finger.

examples.japanese: ⟦ピアノ→ピアノ：01376_piano⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{弾|ひ}く→弾く：02444_hiku⟧⟦とき→時：02918_toki⟧、{中指|なかゆび}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中心|ちゅうしん}→中心：01467_chuushin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}な→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧⟦{役割|やくわり}→役割：03638_yakuwari⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{果|は}たす→果たす：10060_hatasu⟧。
examples.english: When playing the piano, the middle finger plays an important role since it is at the center of the hand.

notes:
USAGE: {中指|なかゆび} is the standard term for the middle finger.

FINGER NAMES:
- ⟦{親指|おやゆび}→親指：04114_oyayubi⟧ (thumb)
- ⟦{人差|ひとさ}し{指|ゆび}→人差し指：11471_hitosashiyubi⟧ (index finger)
- {中指|なかゆび} (middle finger)
- ⟦{薬指|くすりゆび}→薬指：16373_kusuriyubi⟧ (ring finger)
- ⟦{小指|こゆび}→小指：04029_koyubi⟧ (little finger, pinky)

CULTURAL NOTE: Unlike in some Western countries, the middle finger gesture is not traditionally used as an obscene gesture in Japan, though awareness of its Western meaning has increased.
